title: NASA Calculated That China's Three Gorges Dam Lengthens the Day

scenes.text: A dam so big it changes how long a day is.
China's Three Gorges Dam holds back an enormous reservoir of water.
That water now sits higher above sea level than before.
NASA scientist Benjamin Chao calculated that shifts Earth's mass, like a skater extending her arms.
The result: each day gets longer by about 0.06 microseconds.
A tiny change. But a dam moved the planet's spin.
